import sys

def main():
    line = sys.stdin.readline()
    while line.strip() == "":
        line = sys.stdin.readline()
    tam = int(line.strip())
    cad = sys.stdin.readline().strip()

    arr = []
    word = ""
    cont = 0
    mayor = 0
    OUTSIDE, INSIDE = 0, 1
    zone = OUTSIDE

    for i, c in enumerate(cad):
        if c == '(':
            if cont >= mayor:
                mayor = cont
            cont = 0
            zone = INSIDE
        elif c == ')':
            zone = OUTSIDE
            if word:
                arr.append(word)
                word = ""
        elif zone == INSIDE:
            if c != '_':
                word += c
            elif word:
                arr.append(word)
                word = ""
        elif c != '_':
            cont += 1
            if i == tam - 1 and cont >= mayor:
                mayor = cont
        else:
            if cont >= mayor:
                mayor = cont
            cont = 0

    print(f"{mayor} {len(arr)}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
